# Commands

Every PPL command of the OpenSearch command reference and how LynxDB executes it. *full* follows the OpenSearch semantics apart from the listed deviations; *partial* runs with the listed options and limits and rejects the others with an `UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE` error; *unsupported* commands fail with `UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND`.

| Command | Support | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `ad` | unsupported | it runs the OpenSearch ML Commons plugin, which LynxDB does not have |
| `addcoltotals` | full |  |
| `addtotals` | full |  |
| `append` | full |  |
| `appendcol` | full |  |
| `appendpipe` | full | the input is computed twice |
| `bin` | partial | span= with numeric and time units; bins, minspan, aligntime, start, end and logarithmic spans are unsupported |
| `chart` | partial | limit (topN, bottomN), useother, usenull, nullstr, otherstr and span= on splits supported; bins, minspan, start and end unsupported |
| `convert` | full | auto, num, rmcomma, rmunit, memk, dur2sec, mstime, ctime, mktime, none |
| `dedup` | full |  |
| `describe` | partial | returns TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, TYPE_NAME and ORDINAL_POSITION from the values stored in the index |
| `eval` | full |  |
| `eventstats` | partial | bucket_nullable=false and the window functions row_number, rank, dense_rank, percent_rank, cume_dist, nth and ntile are unsupported |
| `expand` | full |  |
| `explain` | partial | returns LynxDB's logical and optimized IR plans; the simple, standard, cost and extended modes render the same plans |
| `fieldformat` | unsupported | display formatting with prefix and suffix is not implemented; use eval with concat() |
| `fields` | full |  |
| `fillnull` | full | without a field list, fills NULL values of the columns each row has |
| `flatten` | partial | aliases are assigned to members in key order |
| `foreach` | unsupported | templated per-field evaluation is not implemented; write one eval per field |
| `graphlookup` | unsupported | recursive graph traversal needs an iterative join operator LynxDB does not have |
| `grok` | partial | built-in library of common patterns (pkg/ppl/grok); custom pattern definitions are not supported |
| `head` | full |  |
| `join` | partial | inner, left, right, full, semi, anti and cross joins with equality keys and a residual condition, overwrite and max; the right side is held in memory |
| `kmeans` | unsupported | it runs the OpenSearch ML Commons plugin, which LynxDB does not have |
| `lookup` | partial | replace, append and output with an explicit output field list |
| `makeresults` | full |  |
| `ml` | unsupported | it runs the OpenSearch ML Commons plugin, which LynxDB does not have |
| `multisearch` | full | results are merged newest first |
| `mvcombine` | full |  |
| `mvexpand` | full |  |
| `nomv` | full |  |
| `parse` | full | RE2 regular expressions: no lookaround or backreferences |
| `patterns` | partial | simple_pattern in label and aggregation modes; a by clause only in aggregation mode; brain and show_numbered_token=true unsupported |
| `rare` | full |  |
| `regex` | full | RE2 syntax |
| `rename` | full |  |
| `replace` | full |  |
| `rest` | unsupported | it reads OpenSearch cluster management endpoints; use the LynxDB REST API |
| `reverse` | full |  |
| `rex` | partial | extract mode and sed s/regex/replacement/[g]; offset_field unsupported; RE2 syntax |
| `search` | partial | free-text terms match whole tokens of the event's raw text through the term index (OpenSearch searches all fields); quoted phrases match at token boundaries; field comparisons are exact and case-sensitive; field wildcards match the whole value; time modifiers supported; cross-cluster prefixes are read as part of the index name |
| `show datasources` | unsupported | LynxDB has no external data sources; every index is local |
| `sort` | full | ip(field) sorts by the text form of the address |
| `spath` | partial | auto-extract keeps JSON value types; a JSON null stays NULL |
| `stats` | partial | bucket_nullable supported; partitions, allnum and delim accepted without effect; dedup_splitvalues unsupported; distinct_count is exact up to 10,000 values per group and estimated beyond; output row order is unspecified |
| `streamstats` | partial | current, window and global=false supported; reset_before, reset_after, time_window, and window with global=true and a by clause are unsupported |
| `subquery` | partial | uncorrelated IN, EXISTS and scalar subqueries; a subquery is evaluated once before the outer query; references to outer fields are not supported |
| `table` | full |  |
| `timechart` | partial | span, limit, useother, usenull, nullstr and timefield supported (the default time field is _time); bins and minspan unsupported; per_second, per_minute, per_hour and per_day supported |
| `timewrap` | unsupported | period-over-period wrapping is not implemented; compute the shifted period with eval and join |
| `top` | full |  |
| `transpose` | full |  |
| `trendline` | full |  |
| `union` | full |  |
| `where` | full |  |
| `xyseries` | full |  |
